The '''Servo-Lifter V-2z''' was a [[Power armor/Legends|powersuit]] from [[Verekil]] that vaguely resembled a [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|Binary loadlifter]] with a pilot seat on top. It was described as a "[[Servomotor/Legends|servo]]-enhanced [[Exoskeleton|exo-skeleton]]." Three meters tall, it had two arms, two legs, and two lifting forks. The suit could move at 90 kmh and lift up to 1.5 metric tons; it was commonly used to move heavy cargo in and out of freighters. It cost 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new (7,000 credits used).
